description: Take back the last publish at once: restores the version before it for the pages that publish changed and publishes them, and the undone changes stay as unpublished changes (`restaged`). On a live-mode site nothing is kept (its next save would publish it again): the answer has `redo.version` — restore_version with that version and publish: true brings it back. publishVersion = the version publish_site returned. Fails with not_latest if another publish landed since. If its publish fails, the undo stays as unpublished changes — publish_site finishes it.

publishVersion.description: The version the publish to undo returned.

name: undo_publish
